coordinates: body frame of mjcf body 'object' (what PoseReader returns)
frame_convention: primary 'axis' -> frame +z; +x from Gram-Schmidt of 'secondary' (null = body -z) against axis; +y = z cross x

spout_tip.comment: Axis = spout pour direction, derived from SPOUT_YAW_OFFSET = 2.7 rad (yaw of spout from body +x, per view_pour_tea.py calibration). POINT is a guess -- calibrate by double-click-selecting the spout tip in the live viewer and reading body-frame coords, then set status: calibrated. Replaces the SPOUT_YAW_OFFSET constants duplicated across scripts.

handle.comment: Axis = handle long axis (assumed vertical loop handle opposite the spout; if the handle is a top bail, change axis to the horizontal grip direction). Grasp TSR allows sliding along this axis. POINT is a guess.

tilt_axis.comment: Pour pivot axis = z cross spout_dir, anchored at the spout tip, signed so POSITIVE rotation tips the spout DOWN. Point must track spout_tip.point. The pour TSR frame is built from this entry.
